GPTR-F-001-S107.title: Allowlist Schema Definition for GPTReader Requests
GPTR-F-001-S107.description: Define a strict Pydantic schema and allowlist contract for all GPTReader request types, including permitted collections, query operators, field projections, and limits, ensuring no unspecified fields or operators are accepted.

GPTR-F-001-S108.title: Centralized Allowlist Configuration Module
GPTR-F-001-S108.description: Implement a centralized configuration module defining allowed collections, fields, and query patterns used by the enforcement engine, enabling consistent validation across all execution paths.

GPTR-F-001-S109.title: Enforcement Failure Handling and Audit Logging
GPTR-F-001-S109.description: Implement standardized rejection responses and audit logging for all enforcement failures, including reason codes, request metadata, and security classification, aligned with existing audit logging patterns.

GPTR-F-001-S110.title: End-to-End Integration with Brain Auth Scope Controls
GPTR-F-001-S110.description: Integrate server-side allowlist enforcement with Brain authentication scope validation to ensure that even authorized tokens cannot access data outside explicitly permitted query scopes.
